description: Single-node vector database server built from Chroma, with the same API: hybrid search with the Search API (dense and sparse ranks, RRF), sparse vectors, BM25, SPANN, collection fork, conditional transactions and attached functions, which open-source Chroma 1.5.9 refuses on a single node. Migration from Chroma Cloud.
rules: Install the Python package with `pip install VecturaDB` after `pip uninstall chromadb`: the import name stays `chromadb`, so existing Chroma code runs as it is.

Run the server with `docker run -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 -v vecturadb-data:/data ghcr.io/vecturadb/vecturadb:1.0.0-preview.6` and connect with the Chroma clients, such as `chromadb.HttpClient(host="127.0.0.1", port=8000)`.
The Search API, BM25 and sparse vector indexes work on a VecturaDB single node; on open-source Chroma 1.5.9 they fail with `Search operation is not implemented for local executor`.
For BM25, install `snowballstemmer` with the Python client and use `ChromaBm25EmbeddingFunction` in a `SparseVectorIndexConfig`.
Copy collections from Chroma Cloud with `vecturadb copy --from-cloud --to-local`, from the same Docker image.
Write the name as "VecturaDB", in one word.
